name: Oc nui
summary: Ốc núi, mountain snail, is still eaten in the villages around the park and is a Nguồn dish in Minh Hóa.
origin: Buffer villages of Phong Nha-Ke Bang, and Nguồn homes in Minh Hóa.
howToEat: Ask in the buffer villages or in Minh Hóa whether it is on the table.
where: The buffer villages, and Minh Hóa.
seoTitle: Oc nui — mountain snail in the buffer
seoDescription: Ốc núi, mountain snail, is still eaten in the villages around Phong Nha-Ke Bang and in Nguồn homes in Minh Hóa.
